description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to add NATS streaming support within an Orleans silo configuration.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure Orleans silo builder to use NATS streaming.

methods.name: AddNatsStreams (overload 1)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use NATS persistent streams with specific options captured via a configuration action.

methods.name: AddNatsStreams (overload 2)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use NATS persistent streams with a configurator callback.
